zh-CN.title: 楼观道院
zh-CN.subtitle: 关中道教传统与宫观网络的研究入口
zh-CN.shortSummary: 楼观道院作为机构条目，帮助把老子传说、道教人物、宫观空间和后世圣迹叙述区分开来。
curatorialDescription: 本馆将现实地点、道教制度和神圣地理分成不同数据层，避免把传说性地点当作未经说明的历史事实。
条目暂不把楼观概括为整个道教的代表，而是把它作为关中区域的一个研究节点。
zh-CN.researchNote: 需要补充楼观沿革、道教碑刻、人物活动与后世圣迹叙事的年代和证据层。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 隋唐至后世叙述；关中重点

value.zh-CN: 道教宫观与传统记忆节点

en.title: Louguan Daoist institution
en.subtitle: An entry into Guanzhong Daoist traditions and institutional networks
en.shortSummary: As an institutional record, Louguan helps separate Laozi legend, Daoist figures, monastic space and later sacred-site narratives.
curatorialDescription: The museum separates real places, Daoist institutions and sacred geography so legendary sites are not presented as unexplained historical facts.
This record does not treat Louguan as a stand-in for all Daoism; it is a regional research node in Guanzhong.
en.researchNote: Louguan's institutional history, inscriptions, figure associations and later sacred narratives still require dating and evidence-layer review.
en.timeLabel: Sui–Tang and later narratives; Guanzhong focus
